import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_precond (graph : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def succList (g : TopoGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat := (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList

def hasIncoming (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) (u : Nat) : Bool :=
  S.any (fun w => decide (u ∈ succList g w))

def pickSource (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | u :: rest => if hasIncoming g S u then pickSource g S rest else some u

def kahnAux (g : TopoGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Option (List Nat)
  | 0, _ => some []
  | _ + 1, [] => some []
  | fuel + 1, (a :: t) =>
    match pickSource g (a :: t) (a :: t) with
    | none => none
    | some u => (kahnAux g fuel ((a :: t).erase u)).map (fun r => u :: r)

def chainEdge (g : TopoGraph) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: l => g.has_edge a b ∧ chainEdge g (b :: l)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def topological_sort (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (kahnAux graph graph.adj.size (List.range graph.adj.size)).map (fun L => L.toArray)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_postcond (graph : TopoGraph) (result : Option (Array Nat))
    (_ : topological_sort_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle ∧
      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma getD_zero (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma getD_succ (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (n + 1) 0 = l.getD n 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma mem_iff_exists_getD : ∀ (l : List Nat) (x : Nat),
    x ∈ l ↔ ∃ k, k < l.length ∧ l.getD k 0 = x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · intro hex
      obtain ⟨k, hk, _⟩ := hex
      exact absurd hk (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp
        · rw [getD_zero]; exact h.symm
      · obtain ⟨k, hk, hk2⟩ := (ih x).mp h
        refine ⟨k + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
        · rw [getD_succ]; exact hk2
    · intro hex
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hk2⟩ := hex
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        rw [getD_zero] at hk2
        exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl hk2.symm)
      | succ j =>
        rw [getD_succ] at hk2
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hk
        exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ((ih x).mpr ⟨j, by omega, hk2⟩))

lemma list_getD_eq_getElem : ∀ (L : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : k < L.length),
    L.getD k 0 = L[k] := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro k h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro k h
    cases k with
    | zero => rw [getD_zero]; simp
    | succ j =>
      rw [getD_succ]
      have hj : j < t.length := by simp only [List.length_cons] at h; omega
      rw [ih j hj]
      simp

lemma nodup_getD_inj : ∀ (l : List Nat), l.Nodup → ∀ i j, i < l.length → j < l.length →
    l.getD i 0 = l.getD j 0 → i = j := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ i j hi _ _; exact absurd hi (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hnd i j hi hj hij
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at hnd
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      cases j with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ j2 =>
        exfalso
        rw [getD_zero, getD_succ] at hij
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hj
        have hm : t.getD j2 0 ∈ t :=
          (mem_iff_exists_getD t (t.getD j2 0)).mpr ⟨j2, by omega, rfl⟩
        rw [← hij] at hm
        exact hnd.1 hm
    | succ i2 =>
      cases j with
      | zero =>
        exfalso
        rw [getD_zero, getD_succ] at hij
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
        have hm : t.getD i2 0 ∈ t :=
          (mem_iff_exists_getD t (t.getD i2 0)).mpr ⟨i2, by omega, rfl⟩
        rw [hij] at hm
        exact hnd.1 hm
      | succ j2 =>
        rw [getD_succ, getD_succ] at hij
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi hj
        have h5 := ih hnd.2 i2 j2 (by omega) (by omega) hij
        omega

lemma nodup_subset_length_le : ∀ (l1 l2 : List Nat), l1.Nodup → l1 ⊆ l2 →
    l1.length ≤ l2.length := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro l2 _ _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 hnd hsub
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at hnd
    have haL : a ∈ l2 := hsub (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
    have hsub2 : t ⊆ l2.erase a := by
      intro x hx
      have hx2 : x ∈ l2 := hsub (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx))
      have hne : x ≠ a := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hx; exact hnd.1 hx
      exact (List.mem_erase_of_ne hne).mpr hx2
    have h1 := ih (l2.erase a) hnd.2 hsub2
    have h2 : l2.length = (l2.erase a).length + 1 := by
      have h3 := (List.perm_cons_erase haL).length_eq
      simp only [List.length_cons] at h3
      omega
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

lemma getLast?_snoc : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), (l ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by
  intro l a
  induction l with
  | nil => first | rfl | simp
  | cons b t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => first | rfl | simp
    | cons c t' =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, List.getLast?_cons_cons, ← List.cons_append]
      exact ih

lemma exists_append_of_mem : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), a ∈ l →
    ∃ s t, l = s ++ a :: t := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons b t ih =>
    intro a h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
    · exact ⟨[], t, by simp [h1]⟩
    · obtain ⟨s, t', hst⟩ := ih a h1
      exact ⟨b :: s, t', by simp [hst]⟩

lemma chainEdge_nil (g : TopoGraph) : chainEdge g [] := by
  first | exact trivial | simp [chainEdge]

lemma chainEdge_singleton (g : TopoGraph) (a : Nat) : chainEdge g [a] := by
  first | exact trivial | simp [chainEdge]

lemma chainEdge_cons_cons (g : TopoGraph) (a b : Nat) (l : List Nat) :
    chainEdge g (a :: b :: l) ↔ (g.has_edge a b ∧ chainEdge g (b :: l)) := by
  first | exact Iff.rfl | simp [chainEdge]

lemma chainEdge_append_left (g : TopoGraph) : ∀ (l1 l2 : List Nat),
    chainEdge g (l1 ++ l2) → chainEdge g l1 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro l2 _; exact chainEdge_nil g
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 h
    cases t with
    | nil => exact chainEdge_singleton g a
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, chainEdge_cons_cons] at h
      rw [chainEdge_cons_cons]
      refine ⟨h.1, ih l2 ?_⟩
      rw [List.cons_append]
      exact h.2

lemma chainEdge_index (g : TopoGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat), chainEdge g p →
    ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _ i hi; simp at hi
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hch i hi
    cases t with
    | nil => simp at hi
    | cons b r =>
      rw [chainEdge_cons_cons] at hch
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        rw [getD_zero, getD_succ, getD_zero]
        exact hch.1
      | succ j =>
        rw [getD_succ, getD_succ]
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
        exact ih hch.2 j (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)

lemma head?_eq_getD : ∀ (p : List Nat), p ≠ [] → p.head? = some (p.getD 0 0) := by
  intro p
  cases p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t => intro _; rw [getD_zero]; simp

lemma getLast?_eq_getD : ∀ (p : List Nat), p ≠ [] →
    p.getLast? = some (p.getD (p.length - 1) 0) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro _
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b t' =>
      have h1 : (b :: t') ≠ [] := by simp
      have h2 := ih h1
      have h3 : ((a :: b :: t').length - 1) = ((b :: t').length - 1) + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
      rw [h3, getD_succ, ← h2]
      first
        | exact List.getLast?_cons_cons
        | rfl
        | simp

lemma mem_succList_of_has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) (h : g.has_edge u v) :
    v ∈ succList g u := by
  have h2 := h.2
  unfold succList
  first
    | exact (Array.mem_toList).mpr h2
    | exact (Array.mem_toList_iff).mpr h2
    | exact (Array.mem_def).mp h2
    | simpa using h2

lemma has_edge_of_mem_succList (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) (hu : u < g.adj.size)
    (h : v ∈ succList g u) : g.has_edge u v := by
  refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
  unfold succList at h
  first
    | exact (Array.mem_toList).mp h
    | exact (Array.mem_toList_iff).mp h
    | exact (Array.mem_def).mpr h
    | simpa using h

lemma hasIncoming_false_iff (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) (u : Nat)
    (h : hasIncoming g S u = false) : ∀ w ∈ S, u ∉ succList g w := by
  intro w hw hmem
  have h2 : hasIncoming g S u = true := by
    unfold hasIncoming
    exact List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨w, hw, by simpa using hmem⟩
  rw [h] at h2
  exact Bool.noConfusion h2

lemma hasIncoming_true_iff (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) (u : Nat)
    (h : hasIncoming g S u = true) : ∃ w ∈ S, u ∈ succList g w := by
  unfold hasIncoming at h
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hp⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
  exact ⟨w, hw, by simpa using hp⟩

lemma pickSource_some (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) : ∀ (T : List Nat) (u : Nat),
    pickSource g S T = some u → u ∈ T ∧ hasIncoming g S u = false := by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | nil => intro u h; simp [pickSource] at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro u h
    by_cases ha : hasIncoming g S a = true
    · simp only [pickSource] at h
      rw [if_pos ha] at h
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := ih u h
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h3), h4⟩
    · simp only [pickSource] at h
      rw [if_neg ha] at h
      have h5 : a = u := Option.some.inj h
      subst h5
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), by simpa using ha⟩

lemma pickSource_none (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) : ∀ (T : List Nat),
    pickSource g S T = none → ∀ u ∈ T, hasIncoming g S u = true := by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | nil => intro _ u hu; exact absurd hu (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h u hu
    by_cases ha : hasIncoming g S a = true
    · simp only [pickSource] at h
      rw [if_pos ha] at h
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hu with h1 | h1
      · subst h1; exact ha
      · exact ih h u h1
    · simp only [pickSource] at h
      rw [if_neg ha] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp)

lemma kahnAux_zero (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) : kahnAux g 0 S = some [] := by
  first | rfl | simp [kahnAux]

lemma kahnAux_nil (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) : kahnAux g (fuel + 1) [] = some [] := by
  first | rfl | simp [kahnAux]

lemma kahnAux_cons_none (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (a : Nat) (t : List Nat)
    (h : pickSource g (a :: t) (a :: t) = none) : kahnAux g (fuel + 1) (a :: t) = none := by
  first
    | simp only [kahnAux, h]
    | simp [kahnAux, h]
    | (unfold kahnAux; rw [h])

lemma kahnAux_cons_some (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (a : Nat) (t : List Nat) (u : Nat)
    (h : pickSource g (a :: t) (a :: t) = some u) :
    kahnAux g (fuel + 1) (a :: t)
      = (kahnAux g fuel ((a :: t).erase u)).map (fun r => u :: r) := by
  first
    | simp only [kahnAux, h]
    | simp [kahnAux, h]
    | (unfold kahnAux; rw [h])

lemma kahn_some (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (S L : List Nat), S.length ≤ fuel → kahnAux g fuel S = some L →
      L.Perm S ∧ (∀ i j, i < L.length → j < L.length →
        g.has_edge (L.getD i 0) (L.getD j 0) → i < j) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro S L hlen hres
    have hS : S = [] := by
      cases S with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a t => simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen; omega
    subst hS
    rw [kahnAux_zero] at hres
    have hL : L = [] := (Option.some.inj hres).symm
    subst hL
    refine ⟨List.Perm.refl _, ?_⟩
    intro i j hi _ _
    exact absurd hi (by simp)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro S L hlen hres
    cases S with
    | nil =>
      rw [kahnAux_nil] at hres
      have hL : L = [] := (Option.some.inj hres).symm
      subst hL
      refine ⟨List.Perm.refl _, ?_⟩
      intro i j hi _ _
      exact absurd hi (by simp)
    | cons a t =>
      cases hp : pickSource g (a :: t) (a :: t) with
      | none =>
        rw [kahnAux_cons_none g fuel a t hp] at hres
        exact absurd hres (by simp)
      | some u =>
        rw [kahnAux_cons_some g fuel a t u hp] at hres
        obtain ⟨hmem, hnoinc⟩ := pickSource_some g (a :: t) (a :: t) u hp
        cases hrec : kahnAux g fuel ((a :: t).erase u) with
        | none =>
          rw [hrec] at hres
          exact absurd hres (by simp)
        | some rest =>
          rw [hrec] at hres
          have hL : L = u :: rest := by
            first
              | exact (Option.some.inj hres).symm
              | (simp at hres; first | exact hres.symm | exact hres)
          subst hL
          have hperm1 : List.Perm (a :: t) (u :: ((a :: t).erase u)) :=
            List.perm_cons_erase hmem
          have hlen2 : ((a :: t).erase u).length ≤ fuel := by
            have h1 : (a :: t).length = (u :: ((a :: t).erase u)).length := hperm1.length_eq
            simp only [List.length_cons] at h1 hlen
            omega
          obtain ⟨hrperm, hrorder⟩ := ih ((a :: t).erase u) rest hlen2 hrec
          have hsub : ∀ x, x ∈ rest → x ∈ a :: t := by
            intro x hx
            have h1 : x ∈ (a :: t).erase u := hrperm.subset hx
            exact List.mem_of_mem_erase h1
          have hnoedge : ∀ x, x ∈ (a :: t) → ¬ g.has_edge x u := by
            intro x hx he
            exact hasIncoming_false_iff g (a :: t) u hnoinc x hx
              (mem_succList_of_has_edge g x u he)
          refine ⟨(hrperm.cons u).trans hperm1.symm, ?_⟩
          intro i j hi hj he
          cases i with
          | zero =>
            cases j with
            | zero =>
              exfalso
              rw [getD_zero] at he
              exact hnoedge u hmem he
            | succ j2 => omega
          | succ i2 =>
            have hi2 : i2 < rest.length := by
              simp only [List.length_cons] at hi; omega
            cases j with
            | zero =>
              exfalso
              rw [getD_zero, getD_succ] at he
              have hm : rest.getD i2 0 ∈ rest :=
                (mem_iff_exists_getD rest (rest.getD i2 0)).mpr ⟨i2, hi2, rfl⟩
              exact hnoedge _ (hsub _ hm) he
            | succ j2 =>
              have hj2 : j2 < rest.length := by
                simp only [List.length_cons] at hj; omega
              rw [getD_succ, getD_succ] at he
              have h6 := hrorder i2 j2 hi2 hj2 he
              omega

lemma kahn_none (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (S : List Nat), S.length ≤ fuel → (∀ x ∈ S, x < g.adj.size) →
      kahnAux g fuel S = none →
      ∃ T : List Nat, T ≠ [] ∧ (∀ u ∈ T, ∃ w ∈ T, g.has_edge w u) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro S _ _ hres
    rw [kahnAux_zero] at hres
    exact absurd hres (by simp)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro S hlen hlt hres
    cases S with
    | nil =>
      rw [kahnAux_nil] at hres
      exact absurd hres (by simp)
    | cons a t =>
      cases hp : pickSource g (a :: t) (a :: t) with
      | none =>
        refine ⟨a :: t, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro u hu
        have h1 : hasIncoming g (a :: t) u = true :=
          pickSource_none g (a :: t) (a :: t) hp u hu
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hmem⟩ := hasIncoming_true_iff g (a :: t) u h1
        exact ⟨w, hw, has_edge_of_mem_succList g w u (hlt w hw) hmem⟩
      | some u =>
        rw [kahnAux_cons_some g fuel a t u hp] at hres
        obtain ⟨hmem, _⟩ := pickSource_some g (a :: t) (a :: t) u hp
        have hrec : kahnAux g fuel ((a :: t).erase u) = none := by
          cases hq : kahnAux g fuel ((a :: t).erase u) with
          | none => rfl
          | some rest =>
            rw [hq] at hres
            exact absurd hres (by simp)
        have hperm1 : List.Perm (a :: t) (u :: ((a :: t).erase u)) :=
          List.perm_cons_erase hmem
        have hlen2 : ((a :: t).erase u).length ≤ fuel := by
          have h1 : (a :: t).length = (u :: ((a :: t).erase u)).length := hperm1.length_eq
          simp only [List.length_cons] at h1 hlen
          omega
        exact ih ((a :: t).erase u) hlen2
          (fun x hx => hlt x (List.mem_of_mem_erase hx)) hrec

lemma cycle_of_mem (g : TopoGraph) (q r : List Nat) (w : Nat)
    (hchain : chainEdge g (q ++ w :: r))
    (hedge : ∀ x, (q ++ w :: r).head? = some x → g.has_edge w x) :
    g.graph_has_cycle := by
  have hch2 : chainEdge g (q ++ [w]) := by
    apply chainEdge_append_left g (q ++ [w]) r
    rw [List.append_assoc]
    exact hchain
  have hcw : chainEdge g (w :: (q ++ [w])) := by
    cases q with
    | nil =>
      have h1 : g.has_edge w w := hedge w (by simp)
      simp only [List.nil_append]
      rw [chainEdge_cons_cons]
      exact ⟨h1, chainEdge_singleton g w⟩
    | cons b q' =>
      have h1 : g.has_edge w b := hedge b (by simp)
      rw [List.cons_append] at hch2
      rw [List.cons_append, chainEdge_cons_cons]
      exact ⟨h1, hch2⟩
  refine ⟨w :: (q ++ [w]), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro i hi
    exact chainEdge_index g (w :: (q ++ [w])) hcw i hi
  · have h7 : (w :: (q ++ [w])).length = q.length + 2 := by simp
    omega
  · have heq : w :: (q ++ [w]) = (w :: q) ++ [w] := by simp
    have h8 : (w :: (q ++ [w])).getLast? = some w := by
      rw [heq]; exact getLast?_snoc (w :: q) w
    have h9 : (w :: (q ++ [w])).head? = some w := by
      first | rfl | simp
    rw [h8, h9]

lemma cycle_of_mem_list (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) (w : Nat)
    (hch : chainEdge g p) (hw : w ∈ p)
    (hedge : ∀ x, p.head? = some x → g.has_edge w x) : g.graph_has_cycle := by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hqr⟩ := exists_append_of_mem p w hw
  subst hqr
  exact cycle_of_mem g q r w hch hedge

lemma stuck_cycle_aux (g : TopoGraph) (T : List Nat)

import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_precond (graph : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def succList (g : TopoGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat := (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList

def hasIncoming (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) (u : Nat) : Bool :=
  S.any (fun w => decide (u ∈ succList g w))

def pickSource (g : TopoGraph) (S : List Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | u :: rest => if hasIncoming g S u then pickSource g S rest else some u

def kahnAux (g : TopoGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Option (List Nat)
  | 0, _ => some []
  | _ + 1, [] => some []
  | fuel + 1, (a :: t) =>
    match pickSource g (a :: t) (a :: t) with
    | none => none
    | some u => (kahnAux g fuel ((a :: t).erase u)).map (fun r => u :: r)

def chainEdge (g : TopoGraph) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: l => g.has_edge a b ∧ chainEdge g (b :: l)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition

    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (kahnAux graph graph.adj.size (List.range graph.adj.size)).map (fun L => L.toArray)
  -- !benchmark @end code

  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle ∧
      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

        | none =>

          exact absurd hres (by simp)

          rw [hrec] at hres

            first
              | exact (Option.some.inj hres).symm
              | (simp at hres; first | exact hres.symm | exact hres)

            List.perm_cons_erase hmem

            have h1 : (a :: t).length = (u :: ((a :: t).erase u)).length := hperm1.length_eq

    rw [h8, h9]
